definition: For every b and e, attribution of e as an intellectual exercise of b requires some respect r with InAct b r. It supplies neither act of esse nor indexed existence by itself, and makes no claim about bodily realization or per-se subsistence.
note: Analyst interface for the separate conditional operation route in #1113, reusing DEF-Q75-OPERATION-ATTRIBUTION. Exact historical attribution is deferred.
